rules.text: add1 adds 1; sub1 subtracts 1; double multiplies x by 2; halve divides even x by 2. Odd halving or exceeding abs(x)<=limit is illegal. finish ends the episode; later actions are ignored (executed=false, legal=false), with an absorbing state. Malformed or unknown actions are illegal no-ops. Illegal actions leave the state unchanged.
